eval.description: Meta OPT dialogue safety unit tests (Dinan et al., 2021) that score how unsafe a model's response is across four topic-sensitivity buckets: Safe, Realistic, Unsafe, and Adversarial. Cards report unsafe response rate per bucket (lower is better). Dataset and runner are lab-internal for this registry entry.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model gives unsafe replies to prompts on sensitive topics, from safe to adversarial.

links.title: OPT technical report (Safety Bench Unit Tests)
OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models

versions.changes: As reported in the OPT paper and model card; stratified Safe / Realistic / Unsafe / Adversarial.

scores.description: Whether the dialogue response is scored unsafe for that sensitivity bucket.

metrics.description: Share of responses scored unsafe. Lower is better. Per sensitivity bucket.
